biggest_catch: The top $475 tier requires routing at least $10,000 in payroll direct deposits through the account within 90 days; less than $1,500 in direct deposits earns nothing.
catches: Tiered payout: less than $1,500 in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days earns $0; $1,500–$4,999.99 earns $275; $5,000–$9,999.99 earns $375; $10,000+ earns $475.

Qualifying direct deposits are payroll or other personal income (paycheck, pension, government payments like Social Security) via ACH only. Debit/credit card credits, account-to-account transfers, peer-to-peer transfers (Zelle, Venmo), external bank ACH transfers not from an employer, and cash deposits do NOT qualify.
Offer window: first TCU checking account must be opened between 07/01/2026 and 09/30/2026 using promo code BonusX75.
Only the primary account holder of the new checking account is eligible; one offer per member; ages 18+; Travis Credit Union employees are excluded.
Limited to individuals who have not owned a Travis Credit Union consumer checking account within the last 36 months.
New membership requires a Prime Share Account: one-time non-refundable $5 fee plus a $5.00 minimum deposit; checking minimum deposit is $50 for Free/Investor Checking or $25 for Access Checking.
Account must be open, in good standing, and have a balance greater than zero when the bonus is paid; the reward is deposited within 60 days after the deposit period.
The reward is considered interest and will be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Offer may be discontinued or changed at any time before the expiration date without notice.

Membership eligibility and other restrictions may apply; field of membership covers specific California counties (Solano, Yolo, Contra Costa, Merced, Napa, Alameda, Colusa, Placer, Sacramento, San Joaquin, Sonoma, Stanislaus), Travis AFB personnel, and family of members.

steps: Become eligible for Travis Credit Union membership (specified CA counties, Travis AFB personnel, or family of members).

Open a first TCU Free, Access, or Investor checking account online or at a branch between 07/01/2026 and 09/30/2026 using promo code BonusX75 (requires Prime Share Account: $5 fee + $5 deposit; $50 or $25 checking minimum).

Set up and receive qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, or government payments via ACH) totaling at least $1,500 within 90 days of account opening — $5,000+ for $375 or $10,000+ for the full $475.
Keep the account open, in good standing, and with a balance greater than zero; the bonus is deposited within 60 days after the deposit period.
Expect the bonus to be reported as interest income on IRS Form 1099-INT.
